rationale: Fidelity is not uniformly valuable. A member a reconciler dereferences is load-bearing; a member that is always null and that nothing branches on is decoration. Targets with different jobs are held to different bars: m80 aims at every member because exactness is nearly free for a purpose-built emulator, while the floci module is gated on the load-bearing set, which is what CloudFormation provisioning and a reconcile loop actually depend on. Run with -tier load-bearing to score against it.

cosmeticMembers.buildPhaseOverrides: config knob, null in every recorded response, no consumer
cosmeticMembers.cpuConfigurations: config knob, null in every recorded response, no consumer
cosmeticMembers.environmentVariables: config knob, null in every recorded response, no consumer
cosmeticMembers.hooks: config knob, null in every recorded response, no consumer
cosmeticMembers.logging: config knob, null in every recorded response, no consumer
cosmeticMembers.roleConfiguration: config knob, null in every recorded response, no consumer
cosmeticMembers.id: generated uuid; the ARN is the identifier everywhere a client looks
cosmeticMembers.versionStateTimeBucket: service index key leaked into the response, e.g. SUCCESSFUL#26073006
cosmeticMembers.quotaCode: null even on the recorded 402, so nothing can branch on it
cosmeticMembers.serviceCode: null even on the recorded 402, so nothing can branch on it
cosmeticMembers.__type: Smithy error discriminator some emulators add; the SDKs read X-Amzn-Errortype and the live service does not send it in the body

proseMembers.message: human-readable text; status and errorType carry the control flow
proseMembers.Message: the IAM-layer spelling of the same

retainedDespiteAlwaysNull.latestFailedImageVersion: null only because no recorded build failed; a reconciler reads it to detect one
retainedDespiteAlwaysNull.terminationReasonCode: null only because no recorded VM died unexpectedly; it is why a VM died
retainedDespiteAlwaysNull.executionRoleArn: echoed spec, and drift detection compares echoed spec
retainedDespiteAlwaysNull.nextToken: pagination; a client loops until it is null, so its presence is control flow
